programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 #9
programme.desc: 華倫來到歷史名城比勒陀利亞,到訪當地農夫市集,與糕點師郎高斯一起製作扭麻條(南非糯冬甩)。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 #10
programme.desc: 華倫在繁忙的約翰內斯堡的第一站就是充滿活力的索維托小鎮。導遊仙迪帶他乘坐篤篤車​​遊覽,並烹煮了他自己版本的一道南非素菜- 恰卡拉卡。

programme.title: 美國道地料理大搜查 #13
programme.desc: 潛伏在西北水域下的是國內乃至世上最好的海鮮。我們遇到該區的原管理員,並品嚐他們幫助該區茁壯成長的食物。西雅圖的海鮮風貌已發展成為世上最好之一。

programme.title: 美國道地料理大搜查 #14
programme.desc: 我們從一家專門做海鮮的希臘餐廳開始。一路向北前往哈林區與一位紐約美食家一起嘗試一家新餐廳,並品嚐世界上首間高級餐廳的美味佳餚,一切盡在紐約。

programme.title: 生存邊緣 #3
programme.desc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智能統治著地球和我們。人工智能將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #1
programme.desc: 重新檢視新春攻勢: 兩個月的戰役殺死了超過15,000名美國和盟軍士兵,並引發了美國各地的反戰示威。探索報告、圖像和戰鬥片段,當中大部分自1968年以後就再沒出現過。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #2
programme.desc: 按時序再體驗太陽神13號險些釀成的災難,這是美國太空總署同時最具破壞性和最美好的時刻之一。通過新聞片段、任務控制的音頻和美國太空總署的存檔見證1970年4月的事件。

programme.title: 任天堂的故事
programme.desc: 由製造「花札」卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平台。這就是任天堂的故事。

programme.title: PlayStation 的故事
programme.desc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作。但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機。Playstation從此屹立不倒。

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #1
programme.desc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計、生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機。

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #2
programme.desc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求。

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #3
programme.desc: 在下薩克森的邁爾造船廠,世上第一艘天然氣遊輪正在建造當中。這艘337米長的船上可容納多達6,600名乘客、一間電視廣播錄影廠和一座劇院。

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #4
programme.desc: 緊急和特種部隊人員的安全車自有其存在目的。警隊的特種服務車輛是為衝破路障和其他障礙物而設的。

programme.title: 百萬美國公主 2 #3
programme.desc: 目睹集美貌、財富和權力於一身的女人們芭芭拉赫頓、克拉拉沃德和凱薩琳「基克」卡文迪許的悲慘故事,她們嫁給了歐洲貴族,但最終被社會、家庭和她們所期望的幸福結局所唾棄。

programme.title: 百萬美國公主 2 #4
programme.desc: 探索三位美國女性對英國時尚、室內設計甚至國會所產生的影響。南茜阿斯特、南希蘭開斯特和寶蓮德羅斯柴爾德都有不同的出發點,但每位都想出人頭地。

programme.title: 凱特溫斯蕾: 天生女主角
programme.desc: 因《鐵達尼號》而聞名的奧斯卡得主琦溫斯莉因在荷里活猛片和獨立電影中多變而激烈的演技而受讚譽,使她穩佔同代最優秀演員一席位。

programme.desc: 翱翔於廣闊的沙漠、巨大的鑽石和​​世上最大的內陸綠洲之上。

Let’s hear what the experts say!

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Lucy the Staffie cross has been kept inside a dark house for so long that it's affected her eyes and she is extremely overweight She is taken into the RSPCA's care but will Lucy be able to shed some pounds and adapt to life in the great outdoors?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Because of her love for cats, Claire carefully created a place called "There is a Cat at the Corner" While enjoying your meals and drinks, more than a dozen beautiful cats are strolling freely in the store, waiting to interact with you up close and enjoy a slow life with you However, if you want to pet the cat yourself and win their favor, you must first understand the nature and preferences of cats! Claire also generously shares her “experiences in ruling over dozens of cats”, which is extremely precious Novice cat lovers should come and have a look!

programme.title: 王牌司令

programme.title: 脈衝 #2
programme.desc: 渣士、艾盧、當姆和卡斯帕開始測試他們自身和他人瘋狂的底線。在他們身邊,這棟大樓呈現出一種邪惡的生命力。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #76
programme.desc: 亞連使用重生的INNOCENCE神丑擊退千年伯爵,對於與利娜莉等人重逢感到開心。雖然心中仍因未能拯救斯曼而感到懊悔,但利娜莉的話語讓他獲得救贖。此時地面突然出現一個星形紋章,將利娜莉吸了進去。亞連試圖伸手救她,卻險些被拖入其中。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #77
programme.desc: 神田要求亞連等人先走,決定獨自對抗阻擋眾人前行的司金。雖然一行人試圖阻止,他卻不惜使用武器「六幻」,甚至發動招式「界蟲一幻」與他們刀刃相向。大家只好留下神田,繼續趕路。司金與神田對打時,開始在體內貯存龐大能量。

programme.title: 中年男的異世界網購生活 #8
programme.desc: 安妮莫奈因使用魔法而暈倒。康復後,健一為她和瑪麗舉辦烤肉派對,並送繪本給兩人當禮物。看準商機的普莉姆拉決定販售健一的料理,並請曾當過服務生的瑪麗之母賽涅莉亞幫忙,然而賽涅莉亞卻被惡劣的客人纏上!

programme.title: 中年男的異世界網購生活 #9
programme.desc: 普莉姆拉經營的「小憩花冠亭」生意興隆,逐漸受到鎮上居民的喜愛,但她臉上卻不時露出疲憊神色…另一方面,健一與米雅蕾前往新發現的地下城,打算開採大量沉睡的水晶,但卻遭遇巨大洞穴蜘蛛,陷入一場苦戰。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #15
programme.desc: 「去拜訪驅魔的古老眷屬吧」。乙木家收到了妮可的母親・伊吹的新預言。伊吹似乎知道這個「古老眷屬」是指什麼,於是妮可等人決定先去找那些人談談。一方面也因為那裡和乙木家的距離沒有很遠,所以妮可、守仁、監志、圭護以及音夢這五人抱著「暑假出門玩」的心態前往古老眷屬所在的地點。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #16
programme.desc: 吸血鬼霧生見晴成為乙木家的新房客了。因為吸血鬼的特性,使得夜貓子的他才剛搬進來沒多久就開始了睡到下午才起來的悠哉生活。而且,由於他除了一般的食物外還需要額外吸取精氣,每次才剛起床就會跑來向守仁要精氣。在擺明就不適合團體生活的見晴的加入下,乙木家前途多難的生活又將進一步全面升級!?

programme.title: 中年男的異世界網購生活 #10
programme.desc: 健一與尤帕托里姆子爵夫人佳南達成交易,接手了大規模的水渠建設工作。然而連開墾森林的作業都尚未完成,要如期完工簡直難如登天。此外,無良商會索加拉姆的介入也導致費用暴漲。正當健一苦思對策之時,佳南竟還悠哉地對他展開一連串誘惑!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #17
programme.desc: 守仁、監志、圭護和見晴在睡著期間被帶到一個陌生的地方,還被戴上了奇怪的口罩。這時設置在房間裡的螢幕突然啟動,螢幕中的男人對他們說到「我的名字叫吉克薩克,和我玩一場遊戲吧」。奇怪的口罩、變聲器發出的低沉聲音、透過螢幕下達的指示…原來四人被迫參加了一場死亡遊戲。而且…妮可還成為了人質。

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧藍之海 (第一季) #3
programme.desc: 伊織和耕平終於穿上潛水衣、踏入海中了!原本對水中感到害怕的伊織也漸漸被這新世界所吸引。然而潛水用具價格不斐,因此需要資金。於是時田和壽對兩人下達了一項指令,那就是去參加五月舉行的「伊豆春祭」校草選拔比

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧藍之海 (第一季) #4
programme.desc: 「伊豆春祭」正式開始,「PaB」的成員們也擺起了賣什錦燒的攤位。伊織和耕平一起在店裡幫忙,而千紗和梓也輪流負責顧什錦燒的攤位。因為梓的會錯意,加上與網球社團「Tinker Bell」之間的小小摩擦,使伊織周遭的人際關係開始變得複雜起來。就在這樣的情況下,千紗參加的校花選拔也終於要開始了──為了替因為緊張而表情變得僵硬的千紗加油,伊織和耕平想出的策略是什麼呢?而「男X」的結果又會是如何呢!?

programme.title: 中年男的異世界網購生活 #9
programme.desc: 普莉姆拉經營的「小憩花冠亭」生意興隆,逐漸受到鎮上居民的喜愛,但她臉上卻不時露出疲憊神色…另一方面,健一與米雅蕾前往新發現的地下城,打算開採大量沉睡的水晶,但卻遭遇巨大洞穴蜘蛛,陷入一場苦戰。

programme.title: 中年男的異世界網購生活 #10
programme.desc: 健一與尤帕托里姆子爵夫人佳南達成交易,接手了大規模的水���建設工作。然而連開墾森林的作業都尚未完成,要如期完工簡直難如登天。此外,無良商會索加拉姆的介入也導致費用暴漲。正當健一苦思對策之時,佳南竟還悠哉地對他展開一連串誘惑!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #16
programme.desc: 吸血鬼霧生見晴成為乙木家的新房客了。因為吸血鬼的特性,使得夜貓子的他才剛搬進來沒多久就開始了睡到下午才起來的悠哉生活。而且,由於他除了一般的食物外還需要額外吸取精氣,每次才剛起床就會跑來向守仁要精氣。在擺明就不適合團體生活的見晴的加入下,乙木家前途多難的生活又將進一步全面升級!?

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #17
programme.desc: 守仁、監志、圭護和見晴在睡著期間被帶到一個陌生的地方,還被戴上了奇怪的口罩。這時設置在房間裡的螢幕突然啟動,螢幕中的男人對他們說到「我的名字叫吉克薩克,和我玩一場遊戲吧」。奇怪的口罩、變聲器發出的低沉聲音、透過螢幕下達的指示…原來四人被迫參加了一場死亡遊戲。而且…妮可還成為了人質。

programme.desc: 琴子在交織真實與虛構的過程中逐漸逼近案件核心,並聲稱知道真兇身分!昌幸已脫離殺人嫌疑所帶來的危急情況,她進一步表示死亡訊息是真兇為了嫁禍給昌幸而寫下的,他能否接受逐漸明朗化的殘酷真相?

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #78
programme.desc: 神田躲開司金釋放出的強力雷擊,多次以六幻斬向對方,然而司金仍未倒下。當神田束手無策時,發生了地震。他判斷與對手戰鬥的場地即將崩塌,因此以自己的生命為代價,賦予刀劍力量,施展名為「禁忌三幻式」的強大招式。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #79
programme.desc: 神田被司金操縱的鎖鏈綁住,動彈不得,還被強大的電流攻擊無數次。但他仍使出奮力一擊,斬向對手。司金的身體因此遭到INNOCENCE侵蝕,慢慢喪命。此時,司金回想起自己從一個普通人類轉變為諾亞一族的記憶。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #5
programme.desc: 趁著宅邸內一片混亂之際,萊利娜的前未婚夫布魯克斯將她綁走。在馬車中清醒過來的萊利娜嘗試說服綁匪們放走自己,毫不意外地以失敗告終。但她仍抓住馬車因車輪損壞而停下來的破綻逃入森林之中。當她心想總算能穿過樹叢的那一瞬間,有人抓住了她的手。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #6
programme.desc: 萊利娜不小心在努爾的馬上睡著了。當她在隔天早上醒來時,發現自己睡在努爾的臥房,旁邊還躺著赤裸著上半身的他。萊利娜在情急之下拜託亞當幫她逃離此處。被留在房間的努爾命令執事長奇德翁動員所有騎士搜尋兩人,但萊利娜早已為了躲避搜索而假扮成女僕。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #6
programme.desc: 女演員黑川茜在《現在GACHI》中努力突出自己,卻不斷表演卻無法獲得理想的反應,這讓她的焦慮逐漸加重。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #7
programme.desc: 阿奎亞救了小茜脫離危險的境況,她決定繼續參加這個節目。阿奎亞隨後努力消除對她的偏見。

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧藍之海 (第一季) #4
programme.desc: 「伊豆春祭」正式開始,「PaB」的成員們也擺起了賣什錦燒的攤位。伊織和耕平一起在店裡幫忙,而千紗和梓也輪流負責顧什錦燒的攤位。因為梓的會錯意,加上與網球社團「Tinker Bell」之間的小小摩擦,使伊織周遭的人際關係開始變得複雜起來。就在這樣的情況下,千紗參加的校花選拔也終於要開始了──為了替因為緊張而表情變得僵硬的千紗加油,伊織和耕平想出的策略是什麼呢?而「男X」的結果又會是如何呢!?

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧藍之海 (第一季) #5
programme.desc: 伊織和耕平一如往常地穿著一條內褲上課,但今天周遭的視線卻顯得殺氣騰騰。照理說心情應該很不好的千紗面對他們也充滿笑容,令人感覺毛骨悚然……。原來真正的理由,是大家以為伊織和千紗正在交往。感覺到生命危險的兩人表示要負責籌辦聯誼,使得事情變得越來越麻煩。他們請梓介紹女生,但她帶來的女孩卻是吉原愛菜……他們在伊豆春祭遇見的「濃妝子」。

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #5
programme.desc: 六花瞞著琴子和九郎獨自搬到公寓居住。只帶著一個包包,而且沒有保證人的她租到一間連續三人自殺的凶宅。房東的紺野和幸目睹遭車撞飛卻毫髮無傷、對凶宅也毫不動搖的六花後感到不可思議,於是向她詢問搬家理由以及自殺房客們的事。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #5
programme.desc: 趁著宅邸內一片混亂之際,萊利娜的前未婚夫布魯克斯將她綁走。在馬車中清醒過來的萊利娜嘗試說服綁匪們放走自己,毫不意外地以失敗告終。但她仍抓住馬車因車輪損壞而停下來的破綻逃入森林之中。當她心想總算能穿過樹叢的那一瞬間,有人抓住了她的手。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #6
programme.desc: 萊利娜不小心在努爾的馬上睡著了。當她在隔天早上醒來時,發現自己睡在努爾的臥房,旁邊還躺著赤裸著上半身的他。萊利娜在情急之下拜託亞當幫她逃離此處。被留在房間的努爾命令執事長奇德翁動員所有騎士搜尋兩人,但萊利娜早已為了躲避搜索而假扮成女僕。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #78
programme.desc: 神田躲開司金釋放出的強力雷擊,多次以六幻斬向對方,然而司金仍未倒下。當神田束手無策時,發生了地震。他判斷與對手戰鬥的場地即將崩塌,因此以自己的生命為代價,賦予刀劍力量,施展名為「禁忌三幻式」的強大招式。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #79
programme.desc: 神田被司金操縱的鎖鏈綁住,動彈不得,還被強大的電流攻擊無數次。但他仍使出奮力一擊,斬向對手。司金的身體因此遭到INNOCENCE侵蝕,慢慢喪命。此時,司金回想起自己從一個普通人類轉變為諾亞一族的記憶。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #7
programme.desc: 萊利娜收到了弗麗絲答應給她的,於錫克雷特山脈召開的魔物討伐戰邀請函。依照討伐戰慣例,女性將贈送手帕給男性,男性則會將捕捉到的魔物獻給女性。努爾之前從未收下任何人的手帕,也從未獻上魔物給任何人。到了討伐戰當日,努爾對萊利娜提出了某項要求。

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧藍之海 (第一季) #5
programme.desc: 伊織和耕平一如往常地穿著一條內褲上課,但今天周遭的視線卻顯得殺氣騰騰。照理說心情應該很不好的千紗面對他們也充滿笑容,令人感覺毛骨悚然……。原來真正的理由,是大家以為伊織和千紗正在交往。感覺到生命危險的兩人表示要負責籌辦聯誼,使得事情變得越來越麻煩。他們請梓介紹女生,但她帶來的女孩卻是吉原愛菜……他們在伊豆春祭遇見的「濃妝子」。

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧藍之海 (第一季) #6
programme.desc: 伊織與耕平靠著作弊想辦法度過(?)了考試難關。雖然當初在聯誼上吃了不少苦頭,但今天是為「PaB」珍貴的新社員愛菜舉辦歡迎會的日子。愛菜原本期待能在新環境中展開青春的校園生活,然而她很快就察覺到這裡根本就沒有正常人。不過,大家在潛水方面態度倒是十分認真。在學會信號手勢等潛水基礎後,一行人開始以兩人一組結伴進行練習活動。另一方面,始終還沒解開千紗誤會的伊織卻被分到和她同一組……。

programme.desc: 台灣到處有故事, 有充滿創意認真工作的人們, 沿著鐵軌一站站尋找故事, 每個故事是一個點, 就像連連看一樣, 火車將點連成線, 而當這條環島路線跑完時, 就完成一個面, 呈現出真實而全面的新台灣精神

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-不由你不信之從靈界迷惑到真相大白
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」。奉主的名 帶著權柄與邪靈爭戰。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:孫雅各牧師-腓立比書
屬靈教室:李盛林牧師-出埃及記
programme.desc: 前無去路,後有追兵,憑信心過紅海。 雲柱火柱日夜引路,天降嗎哪為持生命。 流浪曠野四十年,以色列人用血﹑淚﹑性命寫成的感人見證! 今天,對你有甚麼啟示呢? 李盛林牧師與你深入探討《出埃及記》中的主要資訊,讓信徒掌握此書卷之意義,並如何落實應用於現今世代。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:燒不燬的荊棘 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:程蒙恩長老-《彼得後書》等候主回來
programme.desc: 程蒙恩長老藉《聖經》彼得後書提醒信徒要警醒等候主回來的要素。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:選擇最重要的 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 福音電影: 最危險人物
programme.desc: 「一代賊王」葉繼歡今晨於瑪麗醫院羈留病房因癌症病逝,終年55歲。 這個曾經手持AK47在街上亂槍掃射、令人聞風喪膽的賊王在被捕、越獄後再犯案。一次偷渡回港時,中槍被捕,成為半身癱瘓的囚犯。 葉繼歡於2004年歸信耶穌,2010年更親筆回信給《天使心》。 今天,小編在整理葉繼歡的書信時,發現了這一句話: 「最後,我想講嘅就係,主令我改變。」

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
茶煲世家#48粵
programme.desc: 明輝清早上班前，要讓出地方給劍棠梳洗，導致上班遲到。劍棠特意為明輝配搭衣著，可惜他的品味甚差，令明輝被同事們取笑。劍棠不滿廣告效果不如理想，竟要家玲下令停播，二人爭執，混亂中以墨水筆弄污家玲的衣服，誤會更深。劍棠自廣告播出後深受歡迎，並接獲新廣告，明輝指此乃家玲功勞。劍棠向家玲道歉，並請眾人到別墅玩樂，劍棠與家玲划艇期間，再次針鋒相對，不歡而散。

programme.title: 驪歌行#43粵普
programme.desc: 大將軍盛驍靖之子盛楚慕對繡坊商戶家的小姐傅柔一見傾心。本來不學無術的他遂決心學習兵法武藝來贏得傅柔的青睞。確定心意的二人回到長安，傅柔展轉間成為女官，盛楚慕也被迫加入軍隊，攜手為國家和百姓作出貢獻。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 為了煮出一窩香滑軟綿的「拆魚粥」，鼎爺帶領阿譚到訪舊式米舖，並分享「糴米」、「糶米」等各種「米知識」。煮粥之前，鼎爺先以皮蛋、熟油醃米，有何作用？他還利用剩下的魚骨，炮製一道惹味的「椒鹽脆骨」。鼎爺又前往粉麵店搜購河粉，順道講解湯河粉與炒河粉的分別，以免大家「入錯貨」。鼎爺再奉上「菜遠牛河」和「乾炒牛河」，還分享兩道「碟頭」美食的掌故。此外，他會傳授輕鬆切出牛肉薄片的竅門，當中「法寶」竟是食油？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 更年期女性有機會受「潮熱」困擾，典型症狀包括突然感到熱及流汗。狀況不僅干擾日常生活，也可能增加患上心血管疾病的風險。婦產科醫生指潮熱主要源於雌激素水平下降，並細說治療相關詳情。剖腹生產手術後或會引發「黏連」，除了可造成腸阻塞，甚至影響日後懷孕機會。另一位婦產科醫生帶來預防黏連的醫療資訊外，也會講述真實個案情況。「睇餸食飯」環節，李家鋌師傅融合意、日元素，炮製一道「甲羅燒焗米型意粉」，香濃惹味。

programme.title: 意外現場粵
programme.desc: 新手爸媽照顧嬰孩手忙腳亂，幸而「金牌陪月」眉精眼企，讓寶寶避過家居危機。爸爸擔心寶寶着涼，貼心蓋被卻可能釀成致命意外！手背試水溫未必準確，手抱嬰孩切忌拋高搖晃。嬰孩接觸香水、樟腦又可會損害健康？陪月被要求為僱主一家兼顧家務，工作指令是否恰當？主人於家中設置監察鏡頭、家傭工作時大玩視像直播，可有觸犯法例？冒失外傭經常損毀家中物品，僱主索償原來有限額。保險公司代表則細述有關家庭傭工的保險須知。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#7粵PG
programme.desc: 駿昇吩咐林磊一定要比冠一早一步找到私生子。曦昕拿着剩下的泥碼大感徬徨，柏義突然親她一下，令籌碼跌出，竟開始讓她贏錢，駿昇答應讓曦昕加入賭場。印度賭王阿星到果欄挑戰「雀后」，家聰應戰卻輸掉了店舖招牌。正花找阿星取回招牌，兆良怕她出事，趕往營救。冠一、丁權找到照相館的舊員工阿昌，向他問話時，突然有一堆人捉走阿昌。冠一質問駿昇，駿昇反指他自作主張、工作不力。柏義收到老人院電話，慌忙趕去。

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 亂太郎三人遇上了二年乙班的時友四郎兵衛，他竟然反覆安裝與拆卸跳箱，讓亂太郎他們想起這個前輩向來都很匪夷所思。就在這時，瀧夜叉丸見到亂太郎三人竟然一反常態，驚慌逃走，細問之下，原來他想避開的人是時友……

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 有數據顯示，香港人每天製造的總垃圾量竟等同於725輛雙層巴士。這麼驚人的數字，當然對地球造成不少負擔。為守護珍貴的環境，小朋友想出一分力，就要細聽環保團體代表分享的減廢方法。嘉賓提出買麵包時可怎樣減少使用膠袋，甚至有方法做到完全不用膠袋，日常生活中還有甚麼舉動可減廢？她又邀主持姐姐猜猜每人一天會產生多少廢物，答案令姐姐大感驚訝，也更深刻體會到減廢的重要。此外，氣球、魚缸玻璃原來不可回收，有何原因？

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 阿驅仍然懷疑御富良院，阿翔提議去找聲稱能識穿任何謊話的Mr騙徒幫忙，Mr騙徒發現御富良院正氣凜然，卻千方百計要陷他於不義，原來前者是炎上達的手下，其目的是要製造混亂，趁機會搶奪七彩方塊。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 今日有樓睇粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
programme.desc: 啟德跑道區一個新盤交樓，大門邊有裂紋及彎曲，浴室去水位生鏽，露台洗衣機也有滴水，應該如何執修？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 宏福苑沒受大火波及的宏志閣，今(3)日暫時解封讓居民收拾物品，記者跟進報道最新情況。大火不僅對屋苑居民造成創傷，也可能對關注災禍的普羅大眾產生心理影響。心理學家分析創傷徵狀，並提供舒緩心理壓力的建議。三名女事主疑遭同一渣男藉結識騙財共約一百萬，渣男以三種身分接近三女，攝製隊前往渣男所述的工作地方，查證並無此人；渣男家人亦指早已與其斷絕關係？皮膚敏感、暗瘡、便秘或跟腸道好壞菌失衡有關，可怎樣改善？

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之開心速遞#2694粵
programme.desc: 天娥意外收到一則自稱退伍軍人誤傳的訊息，竟因此與對方成為朋友。Joe與張愛盈擔心她受騙，勸她終止通訊；怎料其後發現，天娥不僅繼續與騙子聯絡，更與其親身見面，關係似乎非比尋常。天娥甚至曾匯巨款予對方，並發放「私密」照片。二人於是決意「拯救」天娥，以免她越陷越深，並打算設法引出騙子，逼其刪除照片。騙子果然邀約天娥到酒店相聚，Joe依計行事，詎料……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：新聞女王2#16粵PG
programme.desc: 晶耀學院的騙局被揭發，令公開平台登上網媒王座，獲選「駐政總傳媒」之列。家妍不屑與肇華同流合污，下了一個重大決定……慧心要重啟對藥廠的調查，破案關鍵在於舊批次的問題藥物，惟坊間難尋。肇華提拔姜力恆擔任SNK副總監，力恆卻誤打誤撞尋獲有關藥物；慧心成功翻案，令藥廠負責人落網。慧心現身芷瑤的粉絲見面會，兩人再度交鋒，當面清算前因舊怨！慧心於職場上所向披靡，殊不知她最懼怕、最厭惡、最親之人已悄然回歸……

programme.title: 去有風的地方#12粵普
programme.desc: 韶華書屋劉總突襲到訪，其助理張明宇一直拉著紅豆聊天，之遙感到奇怪。紅米勸紅豆去上海有個照應，紅豆拒絕，之遙的開解讓紅豆感受到姐姐對自己的關心。紅豆沒再續租，大嬸們不捨她即將離開，更操心她與之遙的關係。

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：帶阿姐看世界粵
programme.desc: 嘉洛帶阿姐親近澳洲的野生動物，有袋鼠看見阿姐竟然彈開。更有樹熊要阿姐等候？而從其抱抱樹熊瞬間，嘉洛更發現阿姐她罕見一面？二人走進德國村的糖果店盡情掃貨，嘉洛隨後還膽敢向阿姐索吻？旅程尾聲要買手信，吸引阿姐必買的，是甚麼東西？嘉洛好奇心大發，向阿姐推介駝鳥、鱷魚等肉乾，立即試食，反應竟是……搭電車往沙灘放鬆，嘉洛為阿姐奉上禮物，阿姐亦以相同系列物品作回禮，還即席附上鼓勵「金句」，令嘉洛想重聽多N次！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 天氣報告粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
及時雨信貸呈獻:使徒行者2#23粵PG
programme.desc: 少鋒向淑梅說出對她並無感覺，淑梅傷心。天堂知道去找少鋒晦氣，兩人大打出手。嘉莉以代理人身份到集團開會，斯敏帶領她熟習環境，嘉莉卻不慎睡着了。志彬回家時受到神秘人偷襲受傷入院，卓凱前來探望，志彬感動並懊悔不已。志彬跟隨卓凱到警署往見啟發，突然支開卓凱並脅持雪晴。嘉莉與斯敏商討招攬MrWhite的舊客人，而江湖人物King是關鍵，嘉莉竟獨自見他。King說要向Mr White還恩，即舉槍指向嘉莉。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 宏福苑沒受大火波及的宏志閣，今(3)日暫時解封讓居民收拾物品，記者跟進報道最新情況。大火不僅對屋苑居民造成創傷，也可能對關注災禍的普羅大眾產生心理影響。心理學家分析創傷徵狀，並提供舒緩心理壓力的建議。三名女事主疑遭同一渣男藉結識騙財共約一百萬，渣男以三種身分接近三女，攝製隊前往渣男所述的工作地方，查證並無此人；渣男家人亦指早已與其斷絕關係？皮膚敏感、暗瘡、便秘或跟腸道好壞菌失衡有關，可怎樣改善？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 更年期女性有機會受「潮熱」困擾，典型症狀包括突然感到熱及流汗。狀況不僅干擾日常生活，也可能增加患上心血管疾病的風險。婦產科醫生指潮熱主要源於雌激素水平下降，並細說治療相關詳情。剖腹生產手術後或會引發「黏連」，除了可造成腸阻塞，甚至影響日後懷孕機會。另一位婦產科醫生帶來預防黏連的醫療資訊外，也會講述真實個案情況。「睇餸食飯」環節，李家鋌師傅融合意、日元素，炮製一道「甲羅燒焗米型意粉」，香濃惹味。

programme.title: 意外現場粵
programme.desc: 新手爸媽照顧嬰孩手忙腳亂，幸而「金牌陪月」眉精眼企，讓寶寶避過家居危機。爸爸擔心寶寶着涼，貼心蓋被卻可能釀成致命意外！手背試水溫未必準確，手抱嬰孩切忌拋高搖晃。嬰孩接觸香水、樟腦又可會損害健康？陪月被要求為僱主一家兼顧家務，工作指令是否恰當？主人於家中設置監察鏡頭、家傭工作時大玩視像直播，可有觸犯法例？冒失外傭經常損毀家中物品，僱主索償原來有限額。保險公司代表則細述有關家庭傭工的保險須知。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#7粵PG
programme.desc: 駿昇吩咐林磊一定要比冠一早一步找到私生子。曦昕拿着剩下的泥碼大感徬徨，柏義突然親她一下，令籌碼跌出，竟開始讓她贏錢，駿昇答應讓曦昕加入賭場。印度賭王阿星到果欄挑戰「雀后」，家聰應戰卻輸掉了店舖招牌。正花找阿星取回招牌，兆良怕她出事，趕往營救。冠一、丁權找到照相館的舊員工阿昌，向他問話時，突然有一堆人捉走阿昌。冠一質問駿昇，駿昇反指他自作主張、工作不力。柏義收到老人院電話，慌忙趕去。

programme.title: 茶煲世家#48粵
programme.desc: 明輝清早上班前，要讓出地方給劍棠梳洗，導致上班遲到。劍棠特意為明輝配搭衣著，可惜他的品味甚差，令明輝被同事們取笑。劍棠不滿廣告效果不如理想，竟要家玲下令停播，二人爭執，混亂中以墨水筆弄污家玲的衣服，誤會更深。劍棠自廣告播出後深受歡迎，並接獲新廣告，明輝指此乃家玲功勞。劍棠向家玲道歉，並請眾人到別墅玩樂，劍棠與家玲划艇期間，再次針鋒相對，不歡而散。

programme.title: 驪歌行#43粵普
programme.desc: 大將軍盛驍靖之子盛楚慕對繡坊商戶家的小姐傅柔一見傾心。本來不學無術的他遂決心學習兵法武藝來贏得傅柔的青睞。確定心意的二人回到長安，傅柔展轉間成為女官，盛楚慕也被迫加入軍隊，攜手為國家和百姓作出貢獻。

programme.title: 娛樂大家粵
programme.desc: 麥玲玲師傅睇面相有心得，卻被讀唇拼句子考起，幸得上屆港姐冠軍陳曉華幫手。也多得曉華，張彥博才可領悟阿姐的「不醉」魔法，惟泰臣仍一臉茫然……曉華在「狼人」抽中當刺客，與刺客王郭子豪互踩，成功保護另外兩名同黨。另邊廂，將軍突然查殺一位公認的壞人，浪費了功能，更招殺身禍！「真假話題」，玲玲師傅提到曾為女生三小時內覓得情緣，眾人深信真實因家族成員譚嘉儀常有類似遭遇？彥博曾被朋友公開全裸片段，嘉儀竟又知情？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
茶煲世家#49粵
programme.desc: Janet結識新男友，對她百般遷就，耀國等暗地譏諷他有失男子體面。子東等在酒樓用膳時，鄰旁有情侶的言談極為痴纏，竟是耀國。翌日，子東要他帶女友Daisy露面，發覺Daisy專橫野蠻，對耀國的人身自由與經濟完全管束，耀國大為反感，終提出分手。耀國空虛之際，很快便結識貌若天仙新女友Angel，對耀國言聽計從，甚有賢妻良母風範，加上家底豐厚，令同事們羨慕不已，怎料其後發現她是空手道高手，眾人都大嚇一跳。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#1粵普PG
programme.desc: 羅十一娘在回京路上偶遇官府捉拿海盜，期間落水為徐令宜所救，卻以為恩人另有其人。十一娘察覺這次回京事有蹊蹺，關鍵就在徐家春宴。令宜以加賜爵位換取皇上對海禁鬆口，令羅元娘不滿，病重的她誓要為兒子鋪好前路。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 為了炮製兩味鯪魚佳餚，鼎爺帶領阿譚深入本地漁場，嚴選新鮮鯪魚之後，率先奉上「欖角鯪魚蒸五花腩」。五花腩、欖角的香味滲入魚肉，鮮味加倍昇華！鼎爺緊接將鯪魚細心去骨起肉並製成餡料，再釀回魚身內，煎出順德名菜「順德釀鯪魚」。怎樣可令魚皮香脆、魚肉鮮嫩？留意鼎爺「教路」。另外，鼎爺採用紫菜、豆腐、肉碎等既便宜又有營養的食材「滾湯」，帶來「紫菜豆腐肉碎麥豆湯」，順道提供避免肉碎煮成一糰的「小貼士」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 如出現聲音沙啞、咳血等狀況，有可能是聲帶病變。耳鼻喉科醫生指長時間使用聲線的職業屬於高危群組，如病徵持續出現達兩至四星期就應求醫，並帶來診治資訊。臨床心理學家到來，引領觀眾從心理學角度拆解成功，談及的「心理彈性訓練」、「成長型思維」、「自我效能感」代表甚麼概念？嘉賓亦建議家長日常透過讚賞小朋友的努力而非天賦，還分享可製作「感恩日記」訓練正向思維。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨師傅示範「鹵水五花腩拉麵」。

programme.title: 意外現場粵
programme.desc: 馬路如虎口，在停車場泊車亦要慎防種種意外發生。空心少爺為拜金中女製造驚喜，藏於車尾箱的鑽戒卻不翼而飛，停車場可要負責？少爺豪言要將時租停車場當成私人車位，原來泊車逾七天竟屬違法！機動三輪車與電單車相似，但二者的法律規管大有分別，律師詳盡講解。停車場遍佈盲點，車位又短又窄，駕駛專家教車主們如何避免愛車「受傷」。偷取違泊告票「自用」，隨時被控欺詐！「學神」於學車時「衝燈」違反交通規則，又會否扣分？

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#8粵PG
programme.desc: 世峰及丁權見柏義與手信店員工祥哥對話，認定他有事瞞騙。駿昇要曦昕看賭場片段，考驗她能否識破有人在出千，曦昕成功拆解，駿昇看出有人從後協助，曦昕直認是其男友柏義。兆良邀約正花吃飯，正花認為是上天給予機會，讓她可放棄等待冠一。柏義造訪駿昇家，其習慣使駿昇懷疑柏義是天龍之子。正花意外看到當日���一與阿星對賭的片段，決定到澳門向冠一求證心中疑惑。冠一查出柏義身份，只怕他接近駿昇會有危險。

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 風魔流忍術學校的山野金太老師，古澤仁之進還有錫高野與四郎，竟在昨晚一起夢到山村喜三太生了一場大病。與四郎三人在擔心之下，決定穿過山谷，來到海邊的小神殿拜神祈福，求神庇佑喜三太身體健康。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 這回訓練主要圍繞腿部，熱身過後便開始兩款不同形式的深蹲，兒童體適能教練提醒腳趾與膝頭的方向要統一。曲膝躺下，試試用力將臂部推上去，同時胸部與腹部要避免向上推，做起來有一定難度！腿部鍛練後，就要藉「下肢拉伸」動作來舒緩肌肉。坐於瑜伽墊上並伸直一隻腳，雙手伸前嘗試捉緊腳尖，如捉不到可用工具輔助。繼續坐下打開雙腳，雙手向上伸直時將腹部向下壓，盡量拉伸。最後還有一招「香蕉式」，身體如何呈現猶如香蕉的姿態？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 陽葵以驚人姿態出道，成為了憧憬的偶像公主。然而陽葵隨即驚覺，這樣做等同背棄幼時與美月許下的一起出道誓言。而美月也早以小美身分出道，對陽葵同樣懷有愧疚。二人都背負著不敢說的秘密莓，導致關係日漸尷尬……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 由早到晚開的士，乘客來自四方八面，目的地亦各有不同，的士司機可算見盡人生百態，新聞掏寶重溫2003年專題，看看當年的的士司機搵食如何艱難。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵 及 滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之開心速遞#2695粵
programme.desc: 立法會換屆選舉即將舉行，眾人談及此事，提到不少涉及社會政策的民生事項，需要由立法會議員向政府反映意見，因此投票選出可為市民發聲的議員極為重要。城安卻漠不關心，投票意欲欠奉。另一方面，社區中心因欠缺經費維修而暫時關閉，在現任立法會議員助理的協力幫忙下，事情得以解決。眾人對該助理讚譽有加，城安心生妒忌，竟在對方網上直播期間故意「搞事」。其後，城安受到該助理啟發終於知錯，並決意積極參與投票……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：新聞女王2#17粵
programme.desc: 殿堂級記者阮雪君榮獲「威爾斯火炬獎」後衣錦還鄉，其風頭與氣勢比慧心更盛。肇華派人暗中查探雪君的往事，要阻撓方太招攬雪君加入SNK分薄自己的勢力。祝捷晚宴上，雪君當眾猛烈抨擊網媒不負責任，與慧心的理念衝撞，二人針鋒相對，各不相讓。肇華趁火打劫，揭露慧心與雪君的秘密關係……詩晴策劃八台聯播採訪雪君，要激發媒體競爭的同時，也為建立自身功績。八台聯播期間，肇華竟拋出一個有關慧心童年遭遇的震撼彈……

programme.title: 去有風的地方#13粵普
programme.desc: 曉春請紅豆吃飯，之遙同去，卻遇到之前拒絕見面的相親女孩。飯後之遙氣紅豆幫倒忙，但晚上一得知紅豆發燒，又急忙趕去醫院。之遙因勸架被抓傷，紅豆幫他上藥，氣氛曖昧，之遙久久難以平靜，終於在紅豆臨走前表白。

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：帶阿姐看世界粵
programme.desc: 阮浩棕接棒帶阿姐往摩洛哥「看世界」，還貼心準備「Liza遮」為其擋太陽。第一站行逛卡薩布蘭卡市集，阿姐藉薄荷茶感受當地好客之道。置身海景餐廳歎地道料理，浩棕卻向不吃牛肉的阿姐致歉？屹立海面上的宗教地標，散發濃厚的神聖與藝術氣息，二人眼界大開！舍夫沙萬有「藍色之城」美譽，阿姐穿梭美麗小巷盡情打卡，展現購物不講價一面，浩棕更一探民居內的夢幻角落。品嚐當地私房菜風味，浩棕趁機向阿姐探問與家英哥的生活事。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 及時雨信貸呈獻:使徒行者2#24粵PG
programme.desc: 淑梅發現嘉莉似是受了傷，便向卓凱報告，卓凱關心嘉莉的傷勢。淑梅為了尋找少鋒，竟犯險前往福和酒家，天堂出現救了淑梅，最終淑梅為了幫助少鋒，把所知的事告知天堂。卓凱得知歡喜逃去，知有大事發生，決定請好友兼O記的康道行出手相助。歡喜主動與Johnny見面並刺激他，令Johnny對歡喜動殺機……嘉莉放假到別處散心，卓凱到來陪伴，鼓勵她追尋自由，走回正途。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 如出現聲音沙啞、咳血等狀況，有可能是聲帶病變。耳鼻喉科醫生指長時間使用聲線的職業屬於高危群組，如病徵持續出現達兩至四星期就應求醫，並帶來診治資訊。臨床心理學家到來，引領觀眾從心理學角度拆解成功，談及的「心理彈性訓練」、「成長型思維」、「自我效能感」代表甚麼概念？嘉賓亦建議家長日常透過讚賞小朋友的努力而非天賦，還分享可製作「感恩日記」訓練正向思維。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨師傅示範「鹵水五花腩拉麵」。

programme.title: 意外現場粵
programme.desc: 馬路如虎口，在停車場泊車亦要慎防種種意外發生。空心少爺為拜金中女製造驚喜，藏於車尾箱的鑽戒卻不翼而飛，停車場可要負責？少爺豪言要將時租停車場當成私人車位，原來泊車逾七天竟屬違法！機動三輪車與電單車相似，但二者的法律規管大有分別，律師詳盡講解。停車場遍佈盲點，車位又短又窄，駕駛專家教車主們如何避免愛車「受傷」。偷取違泊告票「自用」，隨時被控欺詐！「學神」於學車時「衝燈」違反交通規則，又會否扣分？

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#8粵PG
programme.desc: 世峰及丁權見柏義與手信店員工祥哥對話，認定他有事瞞騙。駿昇要曦昕看賭場片段，考驗她能否識破有人在出千，曦昕成功拆解，駿昇看出有人從後協助，曦昕直認是其男友柏義。兆良邀約正花吃飯，正花認為是上天給予機會，讓她可放棄等待冠一。柏義造訪駿昇家，其習慣使駿昇懷疑柏義是天龍之子。正花意外看到當日冠一與阿星對賭的片段，決定到澳門向冠一求證心中疑惑。冠一查出柏義身份，只怕他接近駿昇會有危險。

programme.title: 茶煲世家#49粵
programme.desc: Janet結識新男友，對她百般遷就，耀國等暗地譏諷他有失男子體面。子東等在酒樓用膳時，鄰旁有情侶的言談極為痴纏，竟是耀國。翌日，子東要他帶女友Daisy露面，發覺Daisy專橫野蠻，對耀國的人身自由與經濟完全管束，耀國大為反感，終提出分手。耀國空虛之際，很快便結識貌若天仙新女友Angel，對耀國言聽計從，甚有賢妻良母風範，加上家底豐厚，令同事們羨慕不已，怎料其後發現她是空手道高手，眾人都大嚇一跳。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#1粵普PG
programme.desc: 羅十一娘在回京路上偶遇官府捉拿海盜，期間落水為徐令宜所救，卻以為恩人另有其人。十一娘察覺這次回京事有蹊蹺，關鍵就在徐家春宴。令宜以加賜爵位換取皇上對海禁鬆口，令羅元娘不滿，病重的她誓要為兒子鋪好前路。

programme.title: 關你家事粵PG
programme.desc: 承上集。年輕事主Wilson分享父親變本加厲的家暴惡行，以及自己離家出走的經過。抑壓多年的Wilson有次忍無可忍，與爸爸大打出手，令父子關係雪上加霜。沒想到事隔多時，家暴困局浮現轉機，而父子和好的關鍵正正發生在Wilson生日那天……家暴所帶來的心理恐懼，並非一聲道歉能夠驅散。肥媽、林雅詩同病相憐，兩位過來人聲淚剖白箇中掙扎。家庭治療師程翠雲又是否鼓勵因家暴而分離的夫妻，為了兒女着想而重修舊好？

programme.title: 關你家事粵PG
programme.desc: 25歲的元仔與妺妹Cynthia小時候，曾撞破爸爸與一位陌生女士態度親暱，又發現他暗地收藏女性裸照、在電話進行曖昧交談等。種種跡象暗示元仔的爸爸大搞外遇，加上父親漠視家庭，令一家人溫馨不再。元仔怨恨父親未有為家庭付出努力，雙方關係陷入僵局。英姐身為元仔、Cynthia的母親，應在子女還小時如實相告丈夫不忠的真相嗎？且聽藝人嘉賓黃智賢、家庭治療師狄志遠和現場觀眾分享看法。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
茶煲世家#50粵
programme.desc: 子敏受同學慫恿，利用買參考書的折扣差價買化妝品，麗娟和子東悉子敏不誠實而不悅。子東接到一男子找子敏的電話，恐他教壞子敏而詳加盤問，子敏尷尬又不滿。子敏同學不慎打爛人家的東西要照價賠償，向子敏等求助，子敏向麗娟借零用，麗娟不肯。一天，麗娟從街坊口中得知子敏在快餐店兼職賺錢，擔心女兒受騙，著子東兄弟到快餐店了解，竟見子敏被一肥仔帶到後巷，子敏並給對方錢，二人見狀即挾持肥仔，經解釋後始知一場誤會。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#2粵普
programme.desc: 十一娘與兩位姐姐來徐家參加春日宴，席間，程國公府的喬蓮房應元娘要求帶眾人去放紙鳶，二娘跟去；元娘帶十一娘撞破徐令宜和蓮房獨處一室，元娘逼迫蓮房嫁入徐府做妾，十一娘看穿元娘設局，猜出自己被挑中做繼室。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 「乾燒伊麵」是中式酒樓、茶餐廳常見的美食，原來做法並不複雜。鼎爺帶阿譚探視製作伊麵的繁複工序後，隨即向家庭觀眾傳授這味「鑊氣」十足的麵食。桂花魚肉質鮮美，廣受普羅家庭的喜愛。鼎爺將桂花魚去骨起肉後切成魚片，再捲起蘆荀及金華火腿絲，蒸煮成味道、賣相兼備的「桂花魚卷」。紅豆沙糖水簡單易做，但要令紅豆沙「起沙」卻要花點功夫。鼎爺巧手奉上「陳皮蓮子百合紅豆沙」，口感香濃綿密、「啖啖沙」，教人垂涎三尺！

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 小腸氣的學名是疝氣，常見於男性、長者與肥胖人士。外科醫生指小腸氣有機會影響腸道血液循環，嚴重時更可導致腸壞死。小腸氣主要透過手術治療，傳統與微創手術各有甚麼優點？旅行天文攝影愛好者暢談緣何自小培養觀星興趣，並介紹觀星的魅力。他提醒觀星時要遵守的基本禮儀，如拍照切勿使用閃光燈。嘉賓推介大埔山區、離島的觀星熱點，也會展示其星空攝影作品，分享深刻觀星經歷。「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅示範「三黃蛋」。

programme.title: 意外現場粵
programme.desc: 有米新郎與拜金新娘有情人終成眷屬，豈料結婚過程險象環生，喜慶現場變成意外現場。攝影師採用航拍技術拍攝婚照，卻不擅操控令航拍機變成傷人武器，現時可有相關法例規管？在斑馬線停留拍照會觸犯交通條例，花車佈置飾物更有可能令司機干犯不小心駕駛。婚宴開席前邀請賓客圍坐「耍樂」，會否構成非法聚賭？兄弟團投入玩樂引致頻頻受傷，還幸有救傷隊代表在場予以正確急救。新郎於宴席上心臟病發不幸離世，臨終遺言竟釀成爭產風波？

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#9粵PG
programme.desc: 冠一、柏義到天龍舊居，傾談下一步行動。正花向冠一求證心中疑惑，冠一的態度儼如陌生人，正花傷心。駿昇為月華準備了生日宴，再向她表白，月華表明仍掛念天龍。冠一、柏義遭人追殺，月華求駿昇停止行動。柏義突然向曦昕提出分手，坦言自己是天龍之子，還被駿昇追殺。曦昕找駿昇對質，駿昇對找到天龍之子感高興，還邀請柏義加入娛樂城董事局。正花喝醉，在麻將桌上自揭出千，只求被人打死……

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 為找尋海中妖怪題材的書籍，第三協榮丸來到忍術學校的圖書室，並在那裡遇上圖書委員能勢久作。協榮丸趁機向能勢炫耀自己的知識與教養，但是當能勢說起圖書委員顧問松千代老師的本領，便令協榮丸感到羞恥，不禁逃走…

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 兒童節目《Hands Up》有「醬汁家族」成員和一眾主持，陪伴大家度過愉快時光。「Kids’ Notes」邀請不同界別人士，跟小朋友分享有趣事物；透過「勇闖小兵團」遊戲，讓孩子們快樂遊玩；運動教練引領大家「Workout 2gether」，鍛練身體；還會透過「Artspiration」，引領孩子了解藝術世界；「My Little Show」開放表演舞台，小朋友到來盡情展示才藝！

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 陽葵終於要接受學生會的訓練，但她完全跟不上學生會成員的步伐，切身感受到自身實力不足，信心受挫。美月見狀，便帶著陽葵前往偶像公主空間到處遊玩。正當美月有事走開時，陽葵遇到一個黑髮的神秘少女。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 今日有樓睇粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之開心速遞#2696粵
programme.desc: 敢威的專用車位遭人佔用，於是命馬漢張貼措辭強硬的告示，以示阻嚇。馬漢「照辦」，但告示的行文卻引來非議。敢威只好辯稱口語化告示有不少好處，還決定將公司所有告示一律改為口語化。這些告示雖然成功引起眾人關注，虹豆沙湯遠卻覺得不妥。其後，有神秘人蓄意撕毀告示，保安部亦束手無策。鐵面陳提到可能是沙湯遠所為，並向敢威提出由他本人負責重新張貼告示，獲得批准……鐵面陳銳意糾正口語化的弊病，卻引發新的問題……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：新聞女王2#18粵
programme.desc: 詩晴不滿肇華騎劫八台聯播，並搶走焦點。SNK進一步揭露慧心不為人知的過去，雪君逼使慧心勇敢面對童年陰影。慧心與雪君亮相公開平台，親身剖白塵封多年的真相與傷痛……無論真相如何，揭露慧心瘡疤只是肇華計劃中的一小部份，其背後的主要目的已經達到。歐洲新聞機構NovusVera計劃進軍香港傳媒市場，代理人雪君出手招兵買馬，率先以高薪厚職招攬家妍，並找詩晴合作為其居中牽線；慧心卻對外資攻港傳聞甚表質疑……

programme.title: 去有風的地方#14粵普
programme.desc: 之遙送紅豆到機場，兩人不捨擁抱告別。紅豆祭拜南星，分享雲南照片和回憶。之遙因思念紅豆而心情低落，奶奶送贈存摺鼓勵他追求紅豆。紅豆寄來桃子，之遙分享給鄉親。之遙迎接書店老闆，拍照傳紅豆，紅豆留言祝順利。

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：帶阿姐看世界粵
programme.desc: 皮革製品是摩洛哥主要輸出品之一，非斯更保留傳統染缸工藝。途經峽谷景點，阿姐、浩棕一探當地嬉水、露營的家庭樂。踏足有逾九千條巷子的非斯古城，隨時會迷路？一睹古法皮染手藝的豐富「色彩」，浩棕更踩上大染缸打卡，背後卻要忍受難頂氣味！買皮革製品做手信，阿姐突擊提問感情事，浩棕即口窒窒……遊走「迷城」選購傳統服飾，還有幸參觀當地人住所，感受風土人情。居民拉茶、擊鼓盛情招待，兩主持興致大發，跟隨節奏舞動起來。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
及時雨信貸呈獻:使徒行者2#25粵PG
programme.desc: 嘉莉回港後提出要離開德信，德信嘗試挽留。少鋒利用替死鬼引出雪晴和其他黑警，主動出擊與眾黑警槍戰，但最終也中彈受傷，只得託撻Q從內地回港幫助他。黑白兩道追捕少鋒，幸卓凱及時救了他，少鋒感動，終向卓凱道出自己的秘密及所知，卓凱將少鋒安置在安全屋。大輝帶天堂來到安全屋，天堂方知受命追殺少鋒，來不及通知少鋒一眾。歡喜帶走少鋒，還提議與他聯手合作，對付德信及黑警。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 小腸氣的學名是疝氣，常見於男性、長者與肥胖人士。外科醫生指小腸氣有機會影響腸道血液循環，嚴重時更可導致腸壞死。小腸氣主要透過手術治療，傳統與微創手術各有甚麼優點？旅行天文攝影愛好者暢談緣何自小培養觀星興趣，並介紹觀星的魅力。他提醒觀星時要遵守的基本禮儀，如拍照切勿使用閃光燈。嘉賓推介大埔山區、離島的觀星熱點，也會展示其星空攝影作品，分享深刻觀星經歷。「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅示範「三黃蛋」。

programme.title: 意外現場粵
programme.desc: 有米新郎與拜金新娘有情人終成眷屬，豈料結婚過程險象環生，喜慶現場變成意外現場。攝影師採用航拍技術拍攝婚照，卻不擅操控令航拍機變成傷人武器，現時可有相關法例規管？在斑馬線停留拍照會觸犯交通條例，花車佈置飾物更有可能令司機干犯不小心駕駛。婚宴開席前邀請賓客圍坐「耍樂」，會否構成非法聚賭？兄弟團投入玩樂引致頻頻受傷，還幸有救傷隊代表在場予以正確急救。新郎於宴席上心臟病發不幸離世，臨終遺言竟釀成爭產風波？

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#9粵PG
programme.desc: 冠一、柏義到天龍舊居，傾談下一步行動。正花向冠一求證心中疑惑，冠一的態度儼如陌生人，正花傷心。駿昇為月華準備了生日宴，再向她表白，月華表明仍掛念天龍。冠一、柏義遭人追殺，月華求駿昇停止行動。柏義突然向曦昕提出分手，坦言自己是天龍之子，還被駿昇追殺。曦昕找駿昇對質，駿昇對找到天龍之子感高興，還邀請柏義加入娛樂城董事局。正花喝醉，在麻將桌上自揭出千，只求被人打死……

programme.title: 茶煲世家#50粵
programme.desc: 子敏受同學慫恿，利用買參考書的折扣差價買化妝品，麗娟和子東悉子敏不誠實而不悅。子東接到一男子找子敏的電話，恐他教壞子敏而詳加盤問，子敏尷尬又不滿。子敏同學不慎打爛人家的東西要照價賠償，向子敏等求助，子敏向麗娟借零用，麗娟不肯。一天，麗娟從街坊口中得知子敏在快餐店兼職賺錢，擔心女兒受騙，著子東兄弟到快餐店了解，竟見子敏被一肥仔帶到後巷，子敏並給對方錢，二人見狀即挾持肥仔，經解釋後始知一場誤會。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#2粵普
programme.desc: 十一娘與兩位姐姐來徐家參加春日宴，席間，程國公府的喬蓮房應元娘要求帶眾人去放紙鳶，二娘跟去；元娘帶十一娘撞破徐令宜和蓮房獨處一室，元娘逼迫蓮房嫁入徐府做妾，十一娘看穿元娘設局，猜出自己被挑中做繼室。

programme.title: 區區開伙粵
programme.desc: 由謝霆鋒提供構思的「黑蒜蓉包」是甚麼味道？家燕姐帶隊到北角區探索。麥包、張美妮帶林欣彤品嚐該區的港式瑞士汁、馬來西亞、潮州滋味。大王、李錦聯精選素食館，新派傳統自助餐兼備，還少不免結伴掃街尋各路美食！

programme.title: 哈皮樂奇鬧翻天

programme.title: 燦爛的風和海
programme.desc: 【賽車手失意澳門 邂逅冷豔策展人共度浪漫情緣】在燈火輝煌的攝影棚與璀璨奪目的澳門之間，廣告導演麥又歌為夢想與責任奔波，結識熱心單純的機車青年徐君樂，在彼此的陪伴下逐漸打開封閉的心門。同時，賽車手韓俊豪在失利陰影與媒體質疑中掙扎，卻因邂逅神秘策展人陳嘉慧，而重新燃起追尋自我的勇氣。四人在工作、夢想與愛情的交織裡相遇，既面對現實的壓力，也學會傾聽心底的渴望。在陌生卻絢爛的城市裡，他們將一同經歷命運的考驗，找尋屬於自己的方向。

programme.title: 陌生人
programme.desc: 【怪力媽搭配毒舌女母女笑鬧同居火花不斷】一個是凡事衝動、毫無對策的媽媽，一個是灑脫率性、走自己路的女兒。原本就像陌生人一樣的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，雞飛狗跳成為日常。從降職的糗事、誤會的桃色風波，到接連不斷的麻煩事件，她們在鬥嘴中暗暗守護彼此。越是嫌棄對方，越是離不開對方——這場「陌生人同居記」，意外寫下母女間最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫朴一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子朴言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而朴言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 我的魯蛇舅舅
programme.desc: 【翻拍BBC人氣英劇／魯蛇舅舅Ｘ強迫症外甥溫馨爆笑的家庭喜劇】由《雖然是精神病但沒關係》的自閉症哥哥吳正世，首次擔任男主角，在選秀節目中獲勝的他，本該朝歌手夢前進，不料積蓄突然遭朋友騙光，從此一蹶不振，成為無業遊名。某天因為姊姊與家暴丈夫離婚，而開始照顧起強迫症的外甥，過程中兩人總是不斷鬥嘴，關係相愛又相殺，而他也從中找回責任感，成為外甥的超人舅舅。

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 玉面桃花總相逢
programme.desc: 本劇改編自藍艾草的同名小說，許清嘉自幼父母雙亡，寒門苦讀成榜眼，與世交胡家的小女胡嬌喜結連理。胡嬌雖然出身屠戶家，不通文墨，但性格開朗積極、不拘小節，將一切打理得井井有條。

programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 玉面桃花總相逢
programme.desc: 本劇改編自藍艾草的同名小說，許清嘉自幼父母雙亡，寒門苦讀成榜眼，與世交胡家的小女胡嬌喜結連理。胡嬌雖然出身屠戶家，不通文墨，但性格開朗積極、不拘小節，將一切打理得井井有條。

programme.title: 功夫莫特
programme.desc: 莫特跟隨師父修行了十年，但一直都只能處理一些和修練無關的瑣事，某天，他們的村莊被妖怪入侵，師父命令莫特去解救村民，並囑咐不可以真面貌示人，執行任務時，必須帶著一個奇怪面具。對於這樣的指示，莫特並不開心。因為所有的村民，包括他暗戀的妙仙，都非常崇拜著面具道士，所以莫特越來越想告訴大家真相…

programme.title: 往哪跑！
programme.desc: 俄羅斯經典動畫系列新作！歡樂悠閒的羅莎渡假村，歡迎世界各地的旅客，在此度過最放鬆的假期！然而，調皮的狼總是想和兔子一爭高下，藉此吸引鹿小姐的注意！

programme.title: 燦爛的風和海(完)
programme.desc: 【賽車手失意澳門 邂逅冷豔策展人共度浪漫情緣】在燈火輝煌的攝影棚與璀璨奪目的澳門之間，廣告導演麥又歌為夢想與責任奔波，結識熱心單純的機車青年徐君樂，在彼此的陪伴下逐漸打開封閉的心門。同時，賽車手韓俊豪在失利陰影與媒體質疑中掙扎，卻因邂逅神秘策展人陳嘉慧，而重新燃起追尋自我的勇氣。四人在工作、夢想與愛情的交織裡相遇，既面對現實的壓力，也學會傾聽心底的渴望。在陌生卻絢爛的城市裡，他們將一同經歷命運的考驗，找尋屬於自己的方向。

programme.title: 我的魯蛇舅舅
programme.desc: 【翻拍BBC人氣英劇／魯蛇舅舅Ｘ強迫症外甥溫馨爆笑的家庭喜劇】由《雖然是精神病但沒關係》的自閉症哥哥吳正世，首次擔任男主角，在選秀節目中獲勝的他，本該朝歌手夢前進，不料積蓄突然遭朋友騙光，從此一蹶不振，成為無業遊名。某天因為姊姊與家暴丈夫離婚，而開始照顧起強迫症的外甥，過程中兩人總是不斷鬥嘴，關係相愛又相殺，而他也從中找回責任感，成為外甥的超人舅舅。

programme.title: 陌生人
programme.desc: 【怪力媽搭配毒舌女母女笑鬧同居火花不斷】一個是凡事衝動、毫無對策的媽媽，一個是灑脫率性、走自己路的女兒。原本就像陌生人一樣的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，雞飛狗跳成為日常。從降職的糗事、誤會的桃色風波，到接連不斷的麻煩事件，她們在鬥嘴中暗暗守護彼此。越是嫌棄對方，越是離不開對方——這場「陌生人同居記」，意外寫下母女間最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫朴一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子朴言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而朴言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.desc: 本劇改編自藍艾草的同名小說，許清嘉自幼父母雙亡，寒門苦讀成榜眼，與世交胡家的小女胡嬌喜結連理。胡嬌雖然出身屠戶家，不通文墨，但性格開朗積極、不拘小節，將一切打理得井井有條。

programme.title: ONE Fight Night 38: Andrade vs. Baatarkhuu
programme.desc: The stars will shine the brightest when the world’s largest martial arts organization returns to the Thai capital for ONE Fight Night 38: Andrade vs. Baatarkhuu. This blockbuster showcase features several martial arts veterans, and it will be topped by a pair of must-see World Title battles. In the headline attraction, ONE Bantamweight MMA World Champion Fabricio Andrade looks to continue his reign of devastation and cap off the year with another highlight-reel knockout for the ages. But #4-ranked contender Enkh-Orgil Baatarkhuu, who is fresh off his appearance on Netflix’s Physical: 100, wants to follow in the footsteps of his mentor Narantungalag Jadambaa and become the next Mongolian to capture ONE World Title gold. In the co-main event, two-time ADCC World Champion Diogo “Baby Shark” Reis will square off against Japanese BJJ black belt Daiki Yonekura for the ONE Flyweight Submission Grappling World Title. Plus, British Muay Thai legend Liam Harrison, BJJ icon Marcelo Garcia...

programme.title: Thomas Edison's Secret Lab - Burpin’ Babies / Backpack Payback - EP118
programme.desc: Kent’s youth serum works a little too well and turns the gang into screaming babies. The serum soon wears off – sort of – now they’re adults trapped in baby bodies and Von Bolt doesn’t know whether to obey or burp them. When the Anti-Matters steal JD's backpack and discover the portable ALVA, they unwittingly cause Edison's hologram to disappear. The Secret Lab Kids must concoct a plan to retrieve the backpack before Edison's lost forever.

programme.desc: When Mum and Dad have a disagreement, Bluey makes Dad write a love letter to Mum to make up. Bluey must find a way to play Ground's Lava with Bingo and deliver the letter to Mum, without squabbling.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - The Quiet Game
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo are playing The Quiet Game and won't use words to tell Dad which toy to buy for Muffin. At his wit's end, Dad recruits new store clerk Alfie to help interpret the girls' miming.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Mr Monkeyjocks
programme.desc: Dad thinks the kids have too many toys and suggests a chuck out. To save their beloved Mr Monkeyjocks from getting the chop, Bluey and Bingo must prove he is special.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Evil Pea's Party Plan
programme.desc: It's Evil Pea's birthday, but she and Carrot are trapped in the bottom of her freezer. They must put their differences aside and work together to escape.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Tour Guide Badge
programme.desc: Gerbie the snake is on holiday and would like to see all the beautiful sights. Duggee can help, he does have his Tour Guide badge!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Sailing Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels are enjoying a day at the beach, when they encounter the Penguins who explain they were on a very important mission when they got sick.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Cool, Man
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Detective Puppy solves the mystery of a missing biscuit, the Rabbits tell us what's cool, and the Squirrels help Delivery Chipmunk with a huge parcel.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Giant's Causeway, Northern Ireland
programme.desc: A Giant Grandmaster Glitch means BIG trouble for the Giant's Causeway!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Golden Gate Bridge, USA
programme.desc: On a very foggy day, The Golden Gate Bridge's foghorns are missing. Can the Go Jetters help?

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch supersizes a fierce Komodo dragon, the Go Jetters must act fast!

programme.title: My World Kitchen (S3) - Marian's Bulgarian Gyuveche
programme.desc: Marian works hard on his traditional gyuveche, layering peppers, tomatoes and feta in beautiful Bulgarian pots and putting an egg on top of each one before it cooks in the oven.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Prairie Dog Pups
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to Chihuahua, Northern Mexico to discover how a colony of black tailed prairie dogs protect their pups from prowling bull snakes, hawks and coyotes as the pups take their critical first steps above ground.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S7) - Davy Jones's Locker
programme.desc: The pirates find a locker washed up on the shore belonging to the legendary pirate Davy Jones. But can they find a way to get to his legendary treasure inside?

programme.title: Panda and Krash (S1) - Monster Ball
programme.desc: The toys are playing for the toyshop blowing championship.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Blue Mountains
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo, Mum and Dad play a game of hand puppets, exploring the land beyond the Blue Mountains where they outsmart the Cheeky Fox to find the softest ever beds.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - The Pool
programme.desc: Packing for the pool, Bluey and Dad tease Mum about being so fussy with what to take. But when they arrive underprepared, they realise a little planning goes a long way.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Shops
programme.desc: Playing 'Shops' is the best game ever for Bluey and her friends - if they can ever get started! With Bluey questioning the rules and changing who's who, they might be here all day!

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Carrot the Champion
programme.desc: A sporty Brussel Sprout, who's training Carrot to do the Ultimate Flip Kick, is Evil Pea in disguise. Evil Pea captures Supertato, but Carrot finally masters the flip kick and rescues him.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Big Ben, England
programme.desc: The Go Jetters visit London on New Year's Eve, but Big Ben is missing! To the Vroomster!

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Like legendary director Chu Yuan did so often and so successfully, Chang Peng Yi adapted this film from a story by Ku Lung. Following the footsteps of the equally legendary Chang Cheh, Chang also casted the majestic Ti Lung, along with "Venoms" Lo Meng and Sun Chien, for a spectacular showcase of mystical Martial Arts World's intrigue and consummate Kung Fu.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: Men From The Monastery
programme.desc: At the end of the Ming Dynasty, Wu San Gui betrays his people to the Qing officials and recruits fighters from all backgrounds. Members from Wudan and Ermei are the first to yield and collude with local bullies. When they start attacking the Shaolin Monastery, its most famous disciples have to band together and fight against the enemies.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: Lover's Rock
programme.desc: Pan Lei, winner the China Literary Award for three consecutive years, wrote and directed this film about the lives and loves of a fishing village. It starred the glorious Cheng Pei-pei in her first film as a woman (she had debuted in a man's role), and her much-lauded performance won her the prestigious Golden Accolade Award from the International Association Of Independent Producers a first for any Asian woman.

programme.title: Songfest
programme.desc: As its name implies, Songfest is an Eastmancolor-Shawscope costume musical, traditionally Chinese and timeless in content; yet revealing a spirited and modern technique. Shot on location at Taiwan's beautiful Sun-Moon Lake, it's a turbulent romance between a passionate tea picker Sung Yu Lan and a charming fisherman Li Chun Yang.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: Martial Arts of Shaolin
programme.desc: Zhi Ming, who trains at the Northern Shaolin Temple, teams up with Si Ma Yan, who trains at the Southern Shaolin Temple, to avenge both their fathers' death by assassinating a corrupt magistrate, leading to a series of fierce battles!

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: Lung the Black Enforcer is ordered to escort a murderer Fei to prison. While taking shelter in Lung's house from the snowstorm, Fei is rescued by his gang and Fei kills Lung's mother and sister before escaping. Lung is imprisoned for the failed task and after being released, he vows to avenge his family by killing Fei.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his father's death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiancee enlists a swordsman-who secretly loves her-to search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: Kill Time
programme.desc: Mak stumbles upon an obscure website "Witch's Zone" when looking for a copy of her dead father's favorite song. The mysterious website only allows one purchase but Mak cannot resist buying one more purple scarf. Not only does the scarf triggers her memories of her father and her first love, it may also be a vital clue in a mysterious murder.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead...

programme.title: The Truth: Final Episode
programme.desc: Raymond's lawyer licence is suspended as he has prevented the course of justice to clear his mother's conviction. He is subsequently framed for murder with every piece of evidence pointing towards him. The only one with proof of his innocence is his dying mother, who fights to stay alive long enough to exonerate her son before it is too late.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Protege
programme.desc: Undercover Police Nick has spent 8 years working for the drug baron Quin, so as to collect evidence of his drug trafficking activities. After gaining Quin's trust, Nick becomes his protege and succeeds him as the drug baron when Quin retires. However, Nick has lost himself in his split life between trading drugs and searching for criminal evidence.

programme.title: Golden Chicken
programme.desc: Ah Kam, a seasoned prostitute, gets locked inside an ATM vestibule with a thief. Both discover they are ill-fated in life and Ah Kam starts telling him her life story as a prostitute, from a teenage hooker to a PR girl in an upscale club in her thirties, as well as being a strip dancer, bar girl and masseuse.

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price...

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny appears to be an ordinary housewife but is in fact a mahjong expert. Deeply in love with her husband, she loses to a seductive woman, Curvy, both on the mahjong table and in competing for her husband's love. With the help from her mahjong master, Fanny vows to take on Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from To's father and bitter jealousy from her designated fiance, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Wing is an elite in the police force but has been drowning his guilt in booze after his entire team was killed by the "Gang of Five" in a mission. A year later, a young rookie detective with a complicated background is assigned to partner Wing and manages to inspire him into action, as Wing vows to take down the gang.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Love and Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says "yes". Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliff's ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: The Truth
programme.desc: Orphaned lawyer Raymond Lau once helped clear hooker Lan of murder charges, not knowing that Lan is his mother. When a corrupt cop blackmails Lan with Raymond's identity, she kills him out of desperation. When Raymond is enlisted again to defend Lan, he uncovers the secret that she has been hiding about their relationship for years.

programme.title: Romantic Dream
programme.desc: Dino meets his dream girl Mandy and falls in love with her at first sight. However, she disappears suddenly and he only sees her again after nine years, when she is already married. To overcome the pain of losing his love, Dino finds a guru with supernatural power to make him meet Mandy in his dream.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: The Eye 2
programme.desc: Joey looks to start a new life after a failed suicide attempt but finds herself pregnant and dare not tell her ex-boyfriend. At the same time, she realizes that a mysterious woman is stalking her and begins to hallucinate, leading to a nervous breakdown. Taking advice from an abbot, Joey decides to uncover the truth in order to protect her baby...

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: The Eye 10
programme.desc: This third installment of 'The Eye' horror movie series is about the creepy adventures of a group of teenagers who summon spirits by using the ten methods outlined in a mysterious comic book while vacationing in Thailand.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Golden Chicken 2
programme.desc: The sequel is set in 2046 when a 82-year-old Ah Kam stops a heartbroken young man from taking memory loss pills. To help ease his pain, Ah Kam shares her life stories from 2003, one of Hong Kong's toughest year with SARS, including the different people she comes across and the bittersweet romance between herself and her cousin.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: The Chinese Feast
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: Kill Time
programme.desc: Mak stumbles upon an obscure website "Witch's Zone" when looking for a copy of her dead father's favorite song. The mysterious website only allows one purchase but Mak cannot resist buying one more purple scarf. Not only does the scarf triggers her memories of her father and her first love, it may also be a vital clue in a mysterious murder.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: A Chinese Tall Story
programme.desc: While finding ways to rescue his disciples, Monk Tripitaka meets the lizard imp Mei Yan, the ugliest woman alive. Despite the conflict between good and evil, he falls for Mei Yan who sacrifices herself to save him many times. The Monk breaks his "no killing" rule to save his disciples, and things get more complicated as Princess Galaxy appears...

programme.title: Man Wanted 3
programme.desc: Street kid Dong idolizes Mongkok triad leader Pu Jun and inadvertently joins his gang. When rival Xi Yang seizes control by illicit means, Pu Jun decides to take him down. At the same time, Pu Jun uncovers Dong as a police undercover and banishes him, but Dong sheds his undercover identity to join Pu Jun to seek revenge against Xi Yang.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants And The Hazardous Hysteria Of The Hangry Hypnosinger
programme.desc: Everybody on the spaceship has been cryogenically frozen for three months - everyone, that is, except Krupp, who's wide awake and happily in charge.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Midnight Scrum
programme.desc: When Viggo puts a bounty on Hiccup's head, every Dragon Hunter in the world is after capturing Hiccup, so Toothless and the Riders must rescue him.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Not Lout
programme.desc: When Snotlout screws up a mission, he must learn to be a leader and earn the trust of the other riders.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S2 - Blood Duel
programme.desc: When Zarkon demands a tradeoff, the team has a difference of opinion on what to do; Meanwhile, Haggarobsesses over the past

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Chalk The Line Weighting Is The Hardest Part
programme.desc: Eep cheats her way into being considered an adult; Grug learns he's no longer the strongest caveman and turns to a radical method for building brawn

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Flight of the Fancy
programme.desc: Lucky, Julian and Aunt Cora get swept away in Julian’s new hot air balloon and must fend for themselves in the wilderness

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Picktools
programme.desc: When the crew gets stuck on a sheet of thin ice, they run into a group of Picktools, which appear to be trying to crack the ice around them.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Rumble In The Jungle
programme.desc: Zebby is upset when Raa Raa laughs at her rumbling tummy and runs off to hide. Raa Raa sets out to find his friend and apologise… he thinks it will be easy, he just has to listen out for the sound of her tummy, but who knew how many other rumbling noises there were?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Favourite Noise
programme.desc: Raa Raa is inspired by his friends to search for his favourite noise in the jingly jangly jungle. The little lion cub and his friends set out to find out what Raa Raa's Favourite Noise could be…

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Ooo Ooo Slips Up
programme.desc: Raa Raa and the other animals keep slipping up on banana skins that are littering the jungle floor. Where could they have come from? Together the animals clear up the mess and discover who has been littering the jungle with banana skins.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - No Sleep Til Bedtime
programme.desc: It is nap time in the Jingly Jangly Jungle but Raa Raa is not tired and is determined to play hide and seek with his friends, whether they like it or not! But all this running about can be tiring work for a noisy little lion cub…

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Rainy Day
programme.desc: It is raining in the Jingly Jangly Jungle. Raa Raa is annoyed as he doesn't think he'll be able to play with his friends… until they discover that the rain makes lots of exciting new noises.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Two's Company
programme.desc: Raa Raa and Crocky inadvertently leave one of the others out of all their games. Will they realise that sometimes games can be more fun the more players you have?

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - The Dollhouse Hotel
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a suitcase and a hotel brochure, it’s time to take a trip to The Dollhouse Hotel! Hotel guests Gabby and Pandy check in with the Hotel Manager DJ Catnip then go to Mercat’s Spa and even order room service from Pillow Cat! For our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Pillow Cat sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - A Knight's Tail
programme.desc: Huzzah! Gabby the Bold and Pandy the Purr-owd are Knights in Training, and they head into the dollhouse for the Royal Knighting Ceremony. But it turns out that someone's locked King Catnip in the tower and without him they'll have to cancel the Royal Knighting Ceremony! It's up to the Knights in Training to solve the mystery and save King Catnip by performing acts of knighthood. For our Cat of the Day, Pandy makes a shield craft!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants And The Confusing Crisis Of The Conniving Captive
programme.desc: Melvin isn't exactly their friend ... but it's not like George and Harold can just let him be held captive by diabolical Biglyans, right? Right?!?

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Baby Boss
programme.desc: Mom and Dad are panicking after Gigi noticed Boss isn't growing, so Boss "puts himself under", taking a special formula that will turn him int a regular baby long enough to pass a Doctor's checkup. However, with Boss gone, all the villains from this season see it as the perfect time to strike Baby Corp, leaving Staci to hold the floodgates.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Thunk Tank
programme.desc: When a freak lightning strike turns Thunk into a genius, Phil is thrilled to have someone likeminded on the farm, until the farm residents start asking Thunk for help with problems on the farm instead of him.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Dragon Club
programme.desc: Tom and Jun take a risk in revealing the secret of the Hidden Realm to D’Angelo to aid an injured dragon, and D’Angelo bonds with Plowhorn.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Peng vs. Peng
programme.desc: With the sudden closing of a local candy shop, NaiNai is busy trying to recreate its famous candied fruit. But after a late-night sugar binge in NaiNai’s stash, Peng starts acting strangely. It turns out that he’s possessed by magical creatures! The Minticon are sugar-addicted puffball creatures, who previously lived in the old candy shop. Armed with her violin, Yi commands the creatures out of Peng’s body, winning over the Minticon in the process.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - Troll Playing Game Finn Cascade
programme.desc: Poppy discovers Branch hosting a Trolly roleplaying game in his Bunker. But when she joins the game, she insists on prioritizing fun over the rules, posing in-game problems for Branch. Branch goes to great lengths to get a picture with Finn Cascade, the coolest fish in the Trolls Lagoon. But it seems as though Finn isn’t interested…

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Dollhouse Store Day
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a coin purse with kitty coins, it's Store Day in the dollhouse! Gabby and Pandy help out at all the different stores (Cakey's Bakery, Baby Box's Craft Emporium, Kitty Fairy's Flower Shoppe) to earn kitty coins and save up for a melodicat at the Grand Opening of DJ Catnip’s Music Store!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Fairy's Sleepover
programme.desc: When Gabby, Pandy and the Gabby Cats prepare for a sleepover in the Garden, they discover Pillow Cat has never been to a sleepover. They help her conquer her fears and enjoy her first sleepover.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Message in a Bubble Glitteretti
programme.desc: Kelp has a new trick with his bubbles: he can have his friends put voice messages inside that you hear when you pop them. But when Pixie decides she doesn’t want the others to hear what’s in her bubble, the chase is on to rescue it! Juniper is devastated when the traditional ceremony to celebrate her next level of spark achievement can’t happen. Kelp helps introduce a new tradition.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Talent Show Sad Sad Plant
programme.desc: Kelp writes a song about him and Scallop to perform at the unicorn show. But when it comes time, Scallop wants to keep the song "just for them", leaving Kelp to come up with anew act- and fast! The kids all visit the magical musical plant greenhouse on Unicorn Land. They each pick a plant to take care of, and for Kelp it’s a sad, almost dead plant that he falls in love with.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - The Great Paper Chase Home Is Where Ken's Heart Is
programme.desc: When Rodney draws and writes his own comic book, TZG secretly helps him transport it to the comic book store where creator Ken KaBlam is on the hunt for new talent. When Ken KaBlam gets homesick for his own hometown of Crostonburg, TZG secretly recreates the things me misses in Harmony Harbor.
